name: a validation helper beside registered schema documents is not a new item
about: The new-feature rule counted any new file in a folder of registered schema documents as a sibling that must be registered, so a module of validation helpers blocked the pull request. Judged by structure (no default export, no schema), it is another kind of file and nothing blocks.

files.studio/schemaTypes/documents/index.ts:
import author from './author'
import blog from './blog'
import blogIndex from './blog-index'

export const documents = [author, blog, blogIndex]
files.studio/structure.ts:
export const structure = (S) =>
  S.list().items([
    S.documentTypeListItem('author'),
    S.documentTypeListItem('blog'),
    S.documentTypeListItem('blog-index'),
  ])
